solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

E012-01.notes: Possessive pronoun for 'library': its. it's = it is; their mismatches singular; its' is not a word.

E012-02.notes: Interrupting list opened with a dash must close with a dash. A mixes dash/comma; C leaves dash unclosed; B creates an unclosed comma appositive that reads as a run-on list.

E012-03.notes: 'librarian Dana Whitfield' is the appositive to 'founder', set off by a pair of commas; 'librarian' is a restrictive title with no comma before the name. C lacks the closing comma; D inserts an unpaired dash.

E012-04.notes: Beekeeping/honey detail is irrelevant to the seed library. B describes the prior sentence, not this one; D is false.

E012-05.notes: Faulty comparison: tomatoes must be compared with tomatoes. A/B compare tomatoes to packets; C uses singular 'that' for plural tomatoes and still points to packets.

E012-06.notes: 'In theory... In practice' is the natural contrast; other transitions imply similarity, causation, or example.

E012-07.notes: Comma splice in A; colon correctly introduces the rule that explains 'a simple rule'. C is a fused sentence; D's semicolon plus 'and' is wrong.

E012-08.notes: Hypothetical conditional with 'would double' requires past-tense 'if' clause: returned. 'would return' in the if-clause is nonstandard; 'returns' mismatches the counterfactual (and a third never do).

flags: minor: 'Even so' at the start of the final paragraph has a weak logical link to the preceding 'collection would double' sentence; not tested here but reads oddly
E012-09.notes: Subject is singular 'variety'; intervening plurals (beans, borrowers, years) are the trap. 'has surprised' keeps present-perfect; 'were' is plural and changes meaning; 'having' creates a fragment.

E012-10.notes: Sentence adds a weightier criticism (rents, displacement) and sets up 'these concerns' in the next paragraph. A overclaims ('proves', 'sharply'); C and D misdescribe.

flags: minor: 'it' in D has a slightly remote antecedent (the market) after the preceding sentence about vendors and a mango stall
E012-11.notes: Only D ties back to the market serving neighbors ('a place where neighbors meet'). A is a detail about Ibarra; B is about growth; C is about the library.
